messages.content: What is the fastest route from Los Angeles to New York?

function.name: get_closest_airport
function.description: Find the closest airport to a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city you want to find the nearest airport for.

radius.description: The radius within which to find airports.

limit.description: Limit the number of airports to return. Default: 5

message.reasoning:
User asks: "What is the fastest route from Los Angeles to New York?" They likely want travel route. Could be driving, flight, etc. We can provide options: flight, driving, train. Provide fastest: flight. Provide flight details: direct flight, approximate time. Also mention driving distance ~2,800 miles, ~40 hours. Provide flight time ~5-6 hours. Provide best airlines. Provide route suggestions. Also mention possible layovers. Provide approximate cost. Provide best times. Provide airports: LAX to JFK or EWR. Provide flight duration. Provide fastest route: direct flight. Provide flight schedule. Provide alternative: connecting flights. Provide driving route: I-10, I-40, I-44, I-70, I-81, I-95. Provide approximate. Provide train: Amtrak's "Lake Shore Limited" from LA to NYC? Actually Amtrak doesn't serve LA to NYC directly. There's "Southwest Chief" to Chicago, then "Lake Shore Limited" to NYC. That would be long. So flight is fastest.

We can also mention that the fastest route depends on departure time, but generally direct flight from LAX to JFK/EWR is fastest. Provide flight time ~5h 30m. Provide approximate cost $200-$400. Provide airlines: Delta, United, American. Provide flight times. Provide best times: early morning flights. Provide alternative: connecting flights via Dallas or Chicago.

We can also mention that if you want to drive, you can take I-10 East to I-40 East to I-44 East to I-70 East to I-81 North to I-95 North. Provide approximate route. Provide approximate travel time.

We can also mention that if you want to take a train, you can take Amtrak's "Southwest Chief" to Chicago, then "Lake Shore Limited" to NYC. That would take ~70 hours.

Thus answer: fastest route: direct flight. Provide details. Also mention that if you want to avoid flights, you can drive. Provide approximate route. Provide best times. Provide cost.
